name: Top Donuts
tagline: Donuts, kolaches and coffee with a drive-thru on South Market Street.
about: Top Donuts in Hearne sells glazed, filled and specialty donuts, plus kolaches, croissants and coffee.
There's a drive-thru, and the shop opens at 5 in the morning every day.
hours_source: Hours as listed publicly; call ahead to confirm.
